mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month leads to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.3% in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index above 0.5% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms pass cost increases to consumers via higher valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS exceeding 0.5% in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive decline in both HOUST and RSAFS for two consecutive months signals weakening demand, predicting a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < prev and RSAFS < prev in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both indicators show consecutive declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO supply index below 90 triggers a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates margin expansion.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are non-positive despite INDPRO falling below 90.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4% for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 shows a negative 20-day forward return as investors expect higher borrowing costs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 consecutive months ending at decision date
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during the policy tightening period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower unemployment is misinterpreted as expansionary momentum.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative when UNRATE falls below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial activity) above their 12-month averages for the next month predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12m_avg and HOUST > 12m_avg in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when both proxies exceed their averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in INDPRO indicates structural supply constraints, resulting in a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as valuations adjust downward.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the 4-month INDPRO decline.
